quest.title: The Art of Cooking
quest.description: On the outskirts of the city of Mondstadt, the adventurer Lynn is currently preparing to make a meal...
quest.rewards_formatted: Mushroom x5, Fowl x10, Wheat x5, Bird Egg x5

dialogues.speaker: Lynn
dialogues.text: What should I cook next...?

dialogues.speaker: Lynn
dialogues.text: Oh, are you travelers from around here as well?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No, we just happen to be passing by. *sniff* *sniff* What are you cooking? Smells good!

dialogues.speaker: Lynn
dialogues.text: I see. Welcome, travelers!

dialogues.speaker: Lynn
dialogues.text: I'm Lynn, the survival expert of the Adventurers' Guild. As you can see, I'm experimenting with some new recipes.

dialogues.speaker: Lynn
dialogues.text: "Eat before you go" — The first rule in the "Wilderness Survival Guide."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A picnic! Oh, Paimon just loves picnics!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: My travel partner here is good at cooking as well!

choices.text: I can only cook a few simple dishes...

response.speaker: Lynn
response.text: That's okay. Let's see what you can do!

response.speaker: Lynn
response.text: You won't get a lot of chances like this to learn from a survival expert!

response.speaker: Lynn
response.text: There are some Mushrooms and meat in the barrel over there. Try making a <color=#00E1FFFF>Chicken-Mushroom Skewer</color> for me.

choices.text: That's right, I love cooking too.

response.speaker: Lynn
response.text: Oh, there's a cooking pot right here. Show me what you got!

response.speaker: Lynn
response.text: It's good to have someone to practice with.

talks.objective: Give the Chicken-Mushroom Skewer to Lynn

dialogues.speaker: Lynn
dialogues.text: Is it done? Mmm... Smells good!

dialogues.speaker: Lynn
dialogues.text: Let me try...

dialogues.speaker: Lynn
dialogues.text: Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Lynn
dialogues.text: *nom nom*

dialogues.speaker: Lynn
dialogues.text: Wow...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ahh... Uh oh...

dialogues.speaker: Lynn
dialogues.text: The taste is... hard to describe. A borderline pass!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #What? {NICKNAME} can do better. That doesn't count!

dialogues.speaker: Lynn
dialogues.text: You have great potential. All you need is more practice.

dialogues.speaker: Lynn
dialogues.text: Oh. I've got some raw ingredients in my bag. Have them in return for this meal.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Can we really have them? Won't you run out of ingredients?

dialogues.speaker: Lynn
dialogues.text: That's okay. You should be able to find lots of ingredients when <color=#00E1FFFF>exploring the wilderness</color>. Don't forget to look carefully.

dialogues.speaker: Lynn
dialogues.text: There's also a restaurant in Mondstadt known as <color=#00E1FFFF>Good Hunter</color> that sells food and ingredients. Go have a look when you've got the time.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, thank you for the info. *gasp* Hey! Leave some Chicken-Mushroom Skewers for Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Lynn
dialogues.text: Have you got all the ingredients?

dialogues.speaker: Lynn
dialogues.text: You can use my <color=#00E1FFFF>pot</color> right here. Use it all you want.
